SELECT DISTINCT chunk_id::text FROM rag_chunk_entity WHERE chunk_id IN #{cid}::uuid

INSERT INTO rag_chunk_entity (chunk_id, entity_id, document_id) VALUES
(#{ce.chunkId}::uuid, #{ce.entityId}, #{ce.documentId})
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id, entity_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING chunk_id, entity_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rag_chunk_entity ce USING rag_entity re WHERE re.id = ce.entity_id AND re.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (#{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND re.team_id IS NULL OR re.team_id = #{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag_document d WHERE d.id = ce.document_id AND d.deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rag_chunk_entity ce JOIN rag_entity re ON re.id = ce.entity_id WHERE re.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (#{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND re.team_id IS NULL OR re.team_id = #{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag_document d WHERE d.id = ce.document_id AND d.deleted = 0) )
